news.title: SS Rajamouli Reflects on Filming His Most Violent Sequence with Jr NTR
news.summary: Filmmaker SS Rajamouli recently reflected on shooting what he considers the most violent sequence of his career. Working alongside actor Jr NTR outside the Kerala Assembly, the director expressed doubt about whether filming such a scene would be feasible today.
body: Renowned filmmaker SS Rajamouli has opened up about a notable sequence from his cinematic repertoire, identifying it as the most violent scene he has ever captured on film. The acclaimed director reflected on the demanding production experience, which featured prominent actor Jr NTR.

The intense sequence was filmed on location outside the Kerala Assembly. According to the filmmaker, the logistical and creative realities of shooting such a raw and aggressive sequence back then stand in sharp contrast to current filmmaking environments, leading him to question if executing it would be possible in the present day.

This revelation offers fans and industry followers a rare glimpse into Rajamouli's retrospective thoughts on his directorial journey. Collaborating with Jr NTR for such a high-intensity sequence remains a memorable milestone in the filmmaker's extensive career.
